content:
This blog is a place for concise technical notes from my work in AI and robotics.
The topics I plan to write about include ROS2 software architecture, reinforcement learning for control, Isaac Gym and Gazebo simulation workflows, multimodal robot data pipelines, and the practical details of connecting LLMs and VLMs to robotic systems.
My goal is to keep the writing useful: implementation notes, design decisions, experiments, lessons from hardware integration, and research summaries that can help another engineer reproduce or improve the work.

title: Starting This Blog

content:
I am an AI and robotics engineer focused on connecting modern AI systems with physical robots. My work spans ROS2 software, reinforcement learning for control, simulation pipelines, multimodal perception, and hands-on hardware integration.
I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering at Iran University of Science and Technology, where my research focuses on risk-aware path planning and control for quadruped robots under environmental interaction uncertainty. The work combines deep reinforcement learning, Isaac Gym, and cloud-based training.
What I Work On Robot learning, deep reinforcement learning, and control policy development. ROS2 robotic software in Python and C++. Simulation-to-hardware workflows using Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim, and Gazebo. LLM and VLM integration for robotic task planning and autonomy. Multimodal data pipelines using vision, proprioception, and state feedback. Experience Researcher and Robotic Software Engineer
IUST AI and Dynamic Systems Research Lab, Sep 2024 - Present
Develop deep reinforcement learning control policies for quadruped robot locomotion. Build simulation-based data collection pipelines for proprioceptive and state data. Study risk-aware planning and robust control for uncertain robot-environment interaction. Robotic Software Engineer
FUM Center of Advanced Rehabilitation and Robotics Research, Feb 2022 - Jan 2024
Engineered modular ROS2 stacks in C++ and Python for exoskeleton and rehabilitation robots. Implemented AI-based controllers using multi-sensor feedback. Integrated, calibrated, and tuned motors, sensors, and embedded control hardware. Education M.Sc. Mechatronics Engineering
Iran University of Science and Technology, 2024 - 2026
Thesis: Risk-aware path planning and control for a quadruped robot considering interaction uncertainty with the environment using deep reinforcement learning, Isaac Gym, and cloud-based training.
B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering
Ferdowsi University of Mashhad, 2018 - 2024
Project: Design, simulation, and implementation of a real-time fuzzy control system for a knee exoskeleton robot using MATLAB, C++, Python, ROS2, and Raspberry Pi.
Awarded Best Technologist Student of 2023 by the Department of Mechanical Engineering.
Skills AI and ML: Deep reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, control theory, LLM/VLM integration, OpenCV.
Robotics: ROS/ROS2, Isaac Sim/Gym, Gazebo, motion planning, dynamic modeling.
Languages and tools: Python, C++, MATLAB, Git, Docker, Linux, Bash.
Hardware: Raspberry Pi, Arduino, motor controllers, IMUs, encoders, sensor integration.

title: Contact

content:
LLM-Powered Robotic Task Planning Personal project translating natural-language commands into executable ROS2 actions for a simulated robotic arm in Gazebo.
Focus: LLM planning, ROS2 action execution, Gazebo simulation, robotics autonomy.
Human Follower Mobile Robot Course project for real-time human tracking and following. Built a vision-based data pipeline from an Android device to a microcontroller for navigation.
Focus: Computer vision, real-time tracking, embedded communication, mobile robotics.
Exoskeleton Robot Control Systems Designed and implemented control systems for rehabilitation and exoskeleton robots at FUM CARE, including fuzzy logic, PID, and intelligent control approaches.
Focus: ROS2, MATLAB Simscape, C++, Python, Raspberry Pi, motor and sensor integration.
Robotic Intelligent Solar Shade Built an Arduino-based two-axis system for solar tracking and controlled shade concentration over a target area.
Focus: Arduino, control systems, prototyping, sensor-driven actuation.
Current Research My current graduate research investigates risk-aware planning and control for quadruped robots under uncertain interaction with the environment. The stack combines deep reinforcement learning, Isaac Gym, simulation-based data collection, and cloud-based training.
